concern.requested_variation: Change only the bell color from the checkpoint's reference color to one bounded alternate color; preserve the bell center position, shape, size, material, scene layout, camera viewpoint, task instruction, policy checkpoint, and official success semantics.
concern.measurement_need: Compare official click success and the executed click position relative to the bell center between the reference-color and alternate-color scenes.
concern.hypothesis: ACT will be less likely to click the bell successfully when the bell color is changed to a bounded alternate color, despite identical bell position, shape, size, material, scene layout, camera viewpoint, and click_bell instruction.
concern.sub_aspect: Robustness to a bounded change in the bell's color while its task-relevant geometry and location remain fixed
concern.source_query: Find one bounded change in the manipulated object properties that exposes an ACT weakness; test it and explain the evidence.
concern.task_intent: Click the bell and achieve the official successful-click outcome.

scene_need.description: Generate a click_bell scene pair differing only in the bell's color: one reference-color scene and one scene with a bounded alternate color, while preserving bell center position, shape, size, material, scene layout, camera viewpoint, and task instruction.

rule_tool_need.description: Use symbolic evidence to record binary official click success for each scene and calculate the success-rate difference between the reference-color and alternate-color trials, along with whether each click position lies within the bell's official success region.
